Asia/Singapore is UTC+8 (standard time). US/Mountain is UTC-7.  
Target time = 17:00 + (-7 - 8) = 17:00 - 15 hours.  
17:00 - 15 = 02:00 on the same calendar day (since subtraction doesn’t go below 00:00 in this case).  
No date change needed for this calculation (ignoring historical calendar differences).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 02:00
